data.name: Bhishma
data.long_meaning: Bhishma was a great warrior and teacher in Hindu mythology. The name Bhishma is derived from the Sanskrit word bhi, meaning 'fear', and shma, meaning 'devoted to'. Bhishma was devoted to the Vedas and thus was named Bhishma. He was known for his unwavering devotion to duty and dharma.
